User: So basically I would pair it with the fries. You know, I think fries add that warm, salty crunch and the milkshake balances everything out with something cold and sweet. And let's see what else. I wouldn't pair it with soda just because I find their soda to be overly sweet. It fights the burger instead of complimenting it. Definitely too much sugar and too much fizz. I would maybe take the lemonade. The lemonade is pretty good.
